notes.title: Join us at SimFest Hobby Edition!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39821017/213047f8b750f3ed21a47e7054b8aca6dcd212ab.png

Hello Islanders! We’re very pleased to announce that three of our games will be showcased during the upcoming Steam SimFest Hobby Edition. Starting on the 28th of March our team will once again deliver some fun content from Camping Builder, Hotel Renovator, and Airport Renovator for you to enjoy – and yes, that means more streams from the Two Horizons crew are coming your way!

The SimFest Hobby Edition is an event curated by Steam and this edition celebrates games that attempt to simulate various hobbies – like renovation. Expect a lot of original content prepared by the experts at Steam that will explore the genre and bring it closer to the gaming audience. The event will end on the 4th of April.

Make sure to join our Discord and add Camping Builder to your wishlist to stay updated with the celebrations.

notes.title: What’s the purpose of collecting seashells?
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39821017/7ec294a276dae3569708d2c836684e081167a340.png

Hey Islanders! We’re sure that you’ve come across these beautiful seashells when you were cleaning the beach in the Camping Builder demo, but did you take the time to collect all of them? If you thought that picking them up is a fruitless task then we have some news for you!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39821017/c2decdae534b2a02825d1dfb7ba945d93747bd84.png

The seashells that you find during your playthrough unlock some really cool stuff that you can place on your beach to make it even more attractive for tourists. These additional items are very eye-pleasing and will make for a great decoration around the bungalows and campfire.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39821017/b653518467cfd9261fb2e72f5c055d1c66ad2007.png

Here is the list of unlockable items and the required seashell number to unlock them.


 5 – totem, torch
 10 – hammock, beach chair, table
 15 – bird’s nest
 20 – beach umbrella, surfing boards

If you didn’t feel motivated enough to gather all the seashells before then we hope this short guide will make you jump right back into the demo and unlock all additional items to spruce up your magnificent beaches.

Till next time Islanders!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1545510/Camping_Builder/
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38824567/015ad7d0f37b1b8fc23af0bb5277cd6391897d88.gif

notes.title: The Steam Festival Q&A is here!
notes.content:
As you may already have noticed, our team had their hands full during the Steam Festival and have done their best to provide you with some fun streams and competitions. We are thrilled with the results and that so many of you had downloaded the demo and enjoyed Camping Builder as much as we enjoyed developing it. 

We do, however, have another treat for you! In the video you are about to see, the team answers some fun questions regarding island life. Some of them are pretty straightforward, some of them are a bit tricky, but were answered with complete honesty… well, almost all of them ;)

Watch the video to see what the Two Horizons dev team has to say, and join the fun by leaving your answers in the comments.

notes.title: Thank You all! Steam Next Fest was a blast!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39821017/933d039a54873a19ad0a5a7ecdcf0b49084f929c.png

It’s been a crazy week as every Steam Next Festival is! 

The Camping Builder demo was very well received among the simulator genre and by other gaming fans on Steam. We’ve enjoyed countless hours of your live streams and had lots of fun going through all the YouTube videos we found of your gameplays. Of course, you also gave us feedback, which is the most valuable thing we could get from you. For all that, we thank you!

Some of the game demos featured during this edition of the Festival were of really high quality, and it’s a pleasure that our small game could be seen in the company of such titles. 

Here are some Camping Builder festival statistics for you guys to enjoy!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39821017/70099e09602fdd05df71b467aaca7faef7f058eb.png

The Steam Voucher competition is also going strong, and it’s ending at midnight tonight! You have sent us some great screenshots from the game, and we can't wait to announce the winners. They will all end up getting $20 worth of game vouchers! 

You still have some time to join in! Download the Camping Builder demo and show us your artistic, screenshot-taking soul. Post those on our Two Horizons Discord channel 

Do you have Camping Builder on your wishlist already?

notes.title: Camping Builder Demo Teaser and release date!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39821017/0334b5a1ffec1f34bcc525b1785642ab79407050.png

Demo date - revealed!

Here we go. The super-anticipated demo of our simulator Camping Builder will be out on the 21st of February, as a part of the Steam Next Festival. We simply cannot wait to show you how this incredible game combines the builder/decorator simulation with an ecological aspect, all wrapped up in an engaging story. 

Check out the new teaser we've prepared for you. It only shows a tiny bit of what the game has to offer!


[previewyoutube=d9-MgYHmLSg;full][/previewyoutube]


The Steam Next Festival, a big celebration of Indie games, will be held on Steam from the 21st to the 28th of February. If you want to participate in it, you will be able to play plenty of great game demos for free - totally worth your time! As always, we are bringing out the big guns for that occasion, holding the daily streams, Q&A's and competitions for you to participate in.



https://store.steampowered.com/app/1545510/Camping_Builder/

So hurry up, add the Camping Builder to your wishlist now and celebrate the Steam Next Fest with us next month!

notes.title: Merry Christmas from the Two Horizons crew!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39821017/fb2a799a58b7aaf3664d7c2ce53324914b81df23.png

It has been a wild year for us at Two Horizons. We’ve released two well-received game demos, grown our community, and extended our reach. To a small studio like us, it’s a great indication that we are on the right track. Not only have we bonded together as a team, but we’ve also got close and personal with you guys - our community. It just would not be the same without your feedback and your support.

That’s why we want to wish you all the Christmas you deserve. Full of joy, happiness, and appreciation from family and friends. Let the New Year be even better than we all expect because some fantastic things are coming in 2022!

Merry Christmas!
